page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 9555 processor with 16 physical cores operating at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 80.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU with 96 GB of VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, meaning storage must be provisioned externally.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in single-core CPU execution, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 10%. Large-block memory bandwidth is also highly efficient, reaching 444.94 GB/sec for read-only and 279.59 GB/sec for write operations, both scoring in the top tier. Multi-core CPU performance and database operations fall within the average range. Notably, the GPU-accelerated setup delivers top-tier LLM inference speeds, processing 8554.23 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 234.73 tokens/sec for text generation on a medium 7B model.

The instance offers high resource density for GPU-intensive tasks, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring massive VRAM without the overhead of multi-GPU configurations. However, the shared CPU allocation and average multi-core scaling represent a tradeoff for purely CPU-bound parallel workloads. This server is highly suited for machine learning inference, small-to-medium LLM execution, image processing, and memory-intensive data science tasks.
